#### 1. neuropathy, hereditary motor and sensory, type VIc, with optic atrophy  —  Tier 3 — Moderate / Emerging  (fitness 0.384)

**Proposed mechanism:** PNPO (HGNC:25173) —DISRUPTS→ pyridoxal 5'-phosphate metabolism (GO:0006075); PDXK (HGNC:9408) —DISRUPTS→ pyridoxal 5'-phosphate metabolism (GO:0006075); pyridoxal 5'-phosphate metabolism (GO:0006075) —DECREASES→ pyridoxal 5'-phosphate (CHEBI:17790); pyridoxal 5'-phosphate (CHEBI:17790) —LEADS_TO→ seizure (HP:0001250); pyridoxal 5'-phosphate (CHEBI:17790) —LEADS_TO→ optic atrophy (HP:0000649); pyridoxal 5'-phosphate (CHEBI:17790) —LEADS_TO→ neuropathy (HP:0003691).
